# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Apply `AGENTS.md` as the canonical rules. Start with `docs/00-start-here.md`; for GitHub task operations consult `docs/team/project-config.md`. Use the on-demand skills in `.github/skills/` and approved repo docs; never treat meeting suggestions as binding decisions. Require approval before remote writes, verify issue/board/PR updates, and use `docs/design/identity.md` and tokens for the code-first ArtCraft-friendly workflow.
